The '''Near Pando system''' was located in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It contained the [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Near Pando]] and lay on the [[Pando Spur/Legends|Pando Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the world of [[Far Pando]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Near Pando [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square S-14.<ref name="TEA" />
